reviewer: Independent Japanese reviewer, separate from translation writer
review_scope: Read and independently compared all 202 ordered source Chinese/Japanese paragraph pairs, including each example, quotation, argument, modal qualification, exception and conclusion.
Compared all titles, decks, chapter labels and full entry doors; checked identifiers, source_sha256, counts, source href and chapter consistency with reviewed index.

Reviewed revisable understanding versus fixed interpretation, emotional comfort versus answering reasons, hypotheses versus monopolizing self-explanation, familiarity versus identity fixation, and reasons counting without guaranteeing agreement.

Verified preserved limits: self-deception and evidence remain possible; respecting change does not cancel commitments; serious listening need not end in agreement; emotional intensity neither proves nor invalidates a reason.
Corrected two ambiguous referents and smoothed one deck sentence without changing its claim. Reread final corrected passages in context; retained all remaining text after comparison.
limitations: Japanese11–15 only; no Korean, later batches, rendered HTML, public files or aggregate publication acceptance.
AI linguistic review, not native-speaker editorial certification.
Historical writer report remains untouched. Corrected11 and15 require the final independent hashes rather than the earlier writer snapshot for acceptance.

findings.finding: 自分 could refer to the person being understood rather than the observer whose understanding must remain revisable.
findings.resolution: Used こちらの認識 and an explicit subject to preserve who can revise whose perception.

findings.finding: 私がより快適に暮らせるよう can make the speaker the one living more comfortably, rather than the person whose life is being arranged.
findings.resolution: Specified その人の暮らし as the object being made more comfortable and retained the contrast with that persons own judgment and participation.

findings.finding: Stacked 一度も何の結論も...ない was needlessly awkward.
findings.resolution: Smoothed to どの結論も一度として変えてこなかった, preserving never changed any conclusion.

findings.finding: Full source comparison found no additional correction required.
findings.resolution: Retained argument order, examples, qualifications, chapter terms and link.
